This is not a fair test

1 min read
Just now

--

Press enter or click to view image in full size

The best models only get about 30% of human on ARC-AGI-3.
But that’s raw models re-trying each step with only a listing of past attempts. The harness that ARC provides for consistency.
But real world AGI is attempted through a combination of a multi-modal LLM + its best harness.
We need to see how Cursor, Codex, Claude Code or even Copilot do at ARC-AGI-3.
Withholding the best harness is like saying to the human:
Try the test.
But we’re ripping out your connectome & hippocampus first.
The harness is an intricate part of AI.
It allows use of tools like calculators & spreadsheets. Internal search tools. Better memory management. Multiple prompts tried on the same data. Better hallucination avoidance.
It’s where the most improvement is being achieved today.
They need to test this.
